reviews_5s:
Just what I was looking for. I looked at a lot of different sets, and was surprised at the prices for just simple plastic funnels. This set was a great combination of sizes/shapes and a price I could deal with. Each funnel is obviously good at certain things, and they are not flimsy. My wife snagged one for something specific in the kitchen, one is in the A/C room for putting vinegar in the drain line every month, and two others are in the garage and shed for mower, pressure washer, etc. Working out well, I don't have to go looking for a funnel when I need one anymore, the sweet spot of funnel sets!This funnel works perfectly for the purpose for which I needed it. Every month I have to load a small cleaning unit for my water filter machine with a fine powder. The opening in the cleaning unit is too small for the wider scoop provided with the powder. The result before was that I inevitably spilled powder every time. Searching amazon.com for a suitable funnel to fit into the opening of the cleaning unit yielded this Hopkins 10703 FloTool Spill Saver Radiator Funnel. The funnel arrived in brand-new, very clean condition. All I had to do was to wash the funnel well, dry it thoroughly, and voila! It fits just right into the round opening of the cleaning unit and allows the powder to be poured easily through the wide funnel and into the unit. For those who want to know, the outer diameter of the bottom end of the funnel is 3/4 inch. The diameter of the opening into my cleaning unit is 7/8 inch, so that the funnel fits precisely into it. The happy result is no more spilling of powder. I'm highly pleased and recommend this funnel to anyone for similar use.A funnel for every job around the house. AMAZON: Was it necessary to use a box 4X the item size?If you're looking for one of these funnels, you like working on your car yourself.
Grab this color coded funnel set and feed your car fluids. Stack them for storage and hang it on your garage doorGreat little set of funnels for almost every need! Fuel transfer, oil fill, adding chemical to dilute, etc. Great price, as well!These 4 sizes will cover just about all of my fluid refill needs in the garage. Both the largest and the smallest diameter funnels have extra long spouts which is really helpful. The packaging indicates that they are made in the USA by Hopkins Manufacturing Company, Emporia, Kansas.I like the larger throat on the funnel. It makes things easier to flow through the funnel to the next container. Nothing has ever clogged in the funnel.Nice funnels for the price. Covers a wide range of uses.I like I can refill my wiper without it splashing. My car has a small reservoir so this is perfectI am so glad somebody came up with this. Now when I'm pouring sugar into my gas tank I hardly spill. My gas mileage is going to be way better. The yellow color also lets me know when I forget to take it out.
